formula: resistance=max(prior highs); support=min(prior lows); close beyond buffered boundary plus minimum resistance touches classifies the latest bar
determinism: prior window excludes current bar; at most 50 explicit assets and 1000 rows per asset
fallback_gate: provider, identity, calendar, units or adjustment mismatch is data_not_equivalent
enablement_gate: source unavailable and disabled until trusted host registrar authenticates independent macOS Wind/Excel v2 evidence
